name: David, Panama

rent.notes: No direct listings could be opened (Encuentra24 blocked the fetch), so this range combines 2025-2026 guide figures. Those give unfurnished 2BR from $350, furnished apartments at $500-650 and suburban homes such as Los Algarrobos at $500-700, while modern places run $600-800 and houses in upscale areas $1,000-1,500. A fenced house that accepts a 100 lb dog sits in the middle to upper part of that range.

groceries.notes: Groceries for a couple run about $250-400 a month in Chiriqui, based on a general couple table of $250-350 and a real Boquete couple budget of $400. Dog food adds about $50-70 or more a month, but that figure is a 2019 Panama estimate, so the dog food part is weakly sourced.

utilities.notes: David is hot lowland, so electricity runs about $100-150 a month with A/C. Guides put moderate A/C use at $45-90 and heavy use at $120-250 or more. Water adds $5-25 and a 25 lb propane refill costs $5-8; internet is excluded.

healthcare.notes: Private health insurance premiums for two adults age 60-61. Min is two Family Medical Plan memberships ($117.30 each, ages 60-69); typical and max reflect 2026 local quotes of $6,000-10,000/yr for a couple age 60. Premiums are national and age-rated. Pensionado discounts apply to services, not premiums.

insurance.notes: Re-modeled to renters/contents insurance only, using the Dolega placeholder of $10-20 because the stored David value was health insurance. ExpatDen (Oct 2026) says MAPFRE Hogar and ASSA Hogar do not publish premiums, so no verified price was found.

petDaycare.notes: Boarding costs about $10-30 a night depending on pet size (Relofirm 2025). This assumes an average of about 4-6 nights a month, with a large dog at the upper rate.

sources.title: Bring Pets to Panama: What You Need to Know (Relofirm, Mar 2025)

petGrooming.notes: Full-service grooming costs about $20-40 a session (Relofirm 2025). A large double-coated dog is assumed at the top of that range or slightly above, groomed every 4-8 weeks.

sources.title: Bring Pets to Panama: What You Need to Know (Relofirm, Mar 2025)

transportation.notes: Car insurance is about $500-900 a year ($42-75 a month), per a June 2026 guide. Fuel is 91 octane at about $1.30 a liter (Oct 2026), which comes to roughly $100-150 a month. Maintenance, registration and occasional $1-3 taxis are added on top; a real Chiriqui couple budget shows $263 a month for their car.

entertainment.notes: Mas Movil symmetric fiber costs $39 a month for 600 Mbps or $55 with TV, before 7% tax (Jun 2026). +Movil advertises speeds up to 1 Gbps in Chiriqui, but no price for that tier was found. Dining out costs $30-50 per mid-range meal for 2, three to four times a month, plus streaming and local activities.

phoneCell.notes: Tigo and Mas Movil postpaid plans cost $27 a month per line with unlimited LTE, so two lines come to $54 before tax. A local SIM with 10GB costs about $12, which sets the prepaid low end. The upper end includes an allowance for a US number.

medicalOOP.notes: A GP visit costs $40-80 and a specialist $60-150, with basic labs at $40-80 (2026 guides). The Pensionado discount takes 20% off. Expat reports from David cite doctor visits at $20-50 and specialists at $40-100.
